name: Bosch EDC17CP14

sources: EDC17 CRC directory walk checked on own Hyundai/Kia CP14 reads (not committed) - see docs/BOSCH-CHECKSUM.md

notes: Infineon TriCore common-rail diesel ECU. Diagnostics over CAN (ISO 15765-4, UDS); a complete original typically needs a bench/boot read, while calibration flashing can be done over OBD. The EDC17 checksum is directory-walked; a per-block target constant is shipped for the validated Hyundai/Kia CP14 variants, but VAG and other variants are firmware-specific, so correct those with 'checksum fix --reference <your-own-stock-dump>' (the constant is recovered from your valid read, never guessed). Addresses and flash_size are family placeholders and must be confirmed per software variant before any read or write.
